printed_meter.evidence: Both staves of system 1 print a 2 over a 4 after the three flats and before the first notes.

key.label: three flats
key.evidence: Three flat signs are printed after the opening clef on each staff, before the 2/4. Each later system reprints those three flats. No other signature is printed.

opening_bar.evidence: P001 runs from the barline at x 267 to the barline at x 672 on page 1, system 1. After the three flats and the 2/4, the upper accompaniment is an eighth rest, two sixteenths, an eighth rest, and two sixteenths. That is 2 quarters. The lower staff holds one half note across the same barlines, which is also 2 quarters. The top-voice eighths occupy the same span. P001 is a complete bar, not a pickup.

terminal_bar.evidence: P023 runs from the barline at x 1233 to the thin final stroke at x 1512 on page 1, system 5. The upper melody is four beamed eighths, which is 2 quarters, and the accompaniment under it repeats the eighth-rest and two-sixteenth figure twice, which is also 2 quarters. A thick stroke follows at x 1517-1523 with no repeat dots. P023 is a complete bar, not a partial.

pickup_plus_terminal_vs_meter.explanation: There is no incomplete pickup and no terminal partial. The opening bar and the final bar are each a complete 2/4 bar of 2 quarters, so there is no pickup-plus-terminal sum to compare with the meter.

narrow_complete_bars.evidence: P010 is the narrow bar between x 563 and x 708. The upper staff has two quarter-note chords. The lower staff has a half note. Each is 2 quarters, the printed meter. The bar is narrow because it holds few noteheads, not because it is short of the meter.
P020, between x 746 and x 864, prints two quarter-note chords on the upper staff and a half note on the lower staff. That is 2 quarters.
P022, between x 1095 and x 1233, prints a dotted quarter and an eighth in one upper voice and a half note in the other. That is 2 quarters. The pp of the next bar stands to the right of x 1233.

final_barline.evidence: P023 ends with a thin stroke at x 1512 and a thick stroke at x 1517-1523. No repeat dots are printed beside it.

page_frame.evidence: The page contains only Arietta. Footer text Edition Peters. and plate 8800 sit below the last system and were left on the frozen page. No other movement begins on this page.
